text:
nina: heads-up 1:30 UTC7 — deploy-bot triggered an auto-pin on engine v2.9q during the regional night roll for eu-west. low-volume but repeated eviction traces.

leo: saw alerts. what's the scope?

deploy-bot: [automated] Ephemeral pin applied: engine=v2.9q, reason="eviction-thrash", scope=regional-night-eu-west, ttl=3h, triggered_by=safety-rule-9

harper: I grabbed a sample trace. looks like mixed-quant batches hitting a GC path in the allocator when history > 6k tokens.

nina: thanks. options: (1) let ephemeral expire and monitor, (2) extend TTL, (3) promote to sticky for eu-west only while we ship a micro-bump to allocator.

leo: what's the risk of sticky? availability hit for eu-west during peak if we keep old engine pinned?

harper: sticky keeps v2.9q pinned (no further roll) so lower risk of new regressions but delays rollout benefits. cost minimal. main thing is avoid global sticky.

ops-oncall: user-facing errors so far are small p99 latency blips and a few 5xxs in the night-slice. we've notified SRE but no pager yet.

nina: propose sequence: replay failing traces with debug flags, open PR with allocator micro-bump if repro, then sticky-pin eu-west for 6h during the patch+canary.

leo: agree. can you paste debug env?

harper: use these for replay: 
```
ALLOCATOR_DEBUG=1
KV_EVICT_HIGH_WM=0.88
KV_EVICT_SOFTEN=0.03
BATCH_MERGE_LIMIT=8
```

harper: replay job started: https://internal/replays/job/519876/ (ETA ~18m)

deploy-bot: [automated] Note: ephemeral pins auto-clear at ttl expiry. To promote: `/deploy pin sticky engine v2.9q --region eu-west --reason "allocator micro-bump pending" --expires 6h`

leo: if replay repros, I'll prep allocator tweak PR and a short perf run. aim for canary daytime bake.

harper: replay finished  repro on 3 traces. attached heap dumps and perf counters to the bug: https://issues/internal/ENG-alloc-903

nina: ok let's escalate: leo, open PR; I'll apply sticky pin eu-west for 6h now to stop roll.

leo: PR opened: allocator microbump #813 — changes: increase slab soft threshold, reduce eager reclaim, small regression bench attached.

nina: applying sticky pin now.

deploy-bot: [automated] Sticky pin applied: engine=v2.9q, scope=region:eu-west, reason="confirmed-eviction-repro", expires_in=6h, initiated_by=nina

ops-oncall: adding note to release notes draft and posting to incident channel in case customers see regressions.

leo: I'll queue a fast canary once the microbump lands and report back with p95/p99/oom counts.

harper: small addendum: let's also update safety-rule-9 thresholds to require 2 consecutive windows before auto-pin; I'll open a tiny change.

nina: perfect. action items:
- leo: PR #813 -> land micro-bump and run staged canary (daytime).
- harper: safety-rule tweak PR -> reduce noisy pins.
- ops-oncall: update release notes and triage customer-reports.

nina: closing for now. we'll reconvene if pin TTL is nearing expiry or canary shows issues. :spiral_calendar_pad:
